fusions.name: Drawn Venom
fusions.desc: A bitter bolt draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 16 damage, 60% more for each one drawn. The target is left [Inescapable] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sealed Dose
fusions.desc: Sprays a bitter draught in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 11 damage, stunning everything caught for 0.8 seconds and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbinding Draught
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Run Its Course
fusions.desc: When a condition on you runs out, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
